Bug_Title: Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused
Bug_Explanation: The code attempts to reuse a Stream pipeline after it has been consumed by a terminal operation (findAny). This results in an IllegalStateException as Streams cannot be reused once a terminal operation has been invoked.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of StreamReuseExample, which reuses a Stream pipeline after a terminal operation has been invoked on it, violating Stream usage rules.
